thread:
amy-sales: Heads-up — EdgeBank RFP landed. They want a 30-day POC with an on-prem option, FIPS 140-2 HSM support, per-tenant isolation, and a capability matrix + pricing tiers. I uploaded their security questionnaire to the thread (see link). Need a short written response + matrix by EOD Friday. Any immediate blockers?

kevin-solutions: Thanks. POC infra: do they require dedicated GPUs or can we offer Dedicated (reserved) in their VPC? Also need to confirm data egress restrictions and whether logs can be routed to their SIEM.

amy-sales: @kevin-solutions they said "customer-managed HSM" and strict data residency in us-east-1 only. Logs must go to their Splunk instance via peered VPC.

raj-eng: We can run Redwood Private in their VPC (private control plane) and integrate with external HSMs that support PKCS#11 or KMIP. For the POC we'd recommend 2x GPU nodes (NVIDIA A100 equiv) for predictable latency; can scale if they push throughput.

lisa-security: For the security questionnaire: we'll need to confirm FIPS/HSM attestation, KMS rotation policies, and whether audit logs are WORM. Also clarify network segmentation and MFA for operator access. I can draft answers for the SOC2/Security section.

kevin-solutions: I'll assemble a capability matrix with rows for: hosted API, dedicated reserved, private (VPC), on-prem package, HSM integration (PKCS11/KMIP), kv-cache persistence, streaming, tool-calling, and model quantization options. Pricing: propose two POC options — 30-day hosted credit + pay-as-you-go, or 30-day on-prem trial with fixed engineering support fee.

amy-sales: Good. EdgeBank also asked about fallback behaviour if their HSM becomes unavailable (regulatory concern). Need wording on automatic degraded-mode with KMS fallback and audit trail.

raj-eng: Notes for fallback text: we support a configured key fallback that uses a customer-sealed key held in their KMS; we log all fallback events to a tamper-evident audit stream. For POC we can run HSM mock and then swap to their real HSM during week 2.

kevin-solutions: Draft of the POC ops checklist (short):
```
- Week 0: Network peering + minimal infra (2 GPU nodes)
- Week 1: Deploy private control plane, verify model catalog
- Week 2: HSM integration test (PKCS11), run sample infer load
- Week 3: Latency/cost benchmarks, prefix/KV cache demo
- Week 4: Cutover to customer HSM, run acceptance tests, final report
```

lisa-security: For the questionnaire attachments, attach: FIPS attestation pdf, SOC2 summary, and our operator access playbook. Also include our encryption-at-rest/in-transit one-pager. I'll fill the checkbox answers and note exceptions.

amy-sales: I posted the questionnaire here: https://drive.redwood/edgebank-rfp-sec-q-202403.pdf — please comment inline. Kevin, can you draft the capability matrix by tomorrow morning? Raj, can you provide the HSM integration snippet and the fallback wording? Lisa, please mark any hard no's in the security doc.

kevin-solutions: On pricing: estimate for 30-day on-prem POC w/ eng support = $18k (one-time) + pass-through infra costs (if any). For hosted POC suggest $5k credit + usage at normal rates thereafter. I'll include both in the pricing tab.

raj-eng: HSM connection example (PKCS11) — paste into matrix notes:
```
provider: vendor-hsm
endpoint: pkcs11://10.0.0.45:9000
pin_source: customer-kms
key_wrap: RSA-OAEP-256
notes: requires TLS1.3 and mTLS from control plane
```

lisa-security: A couple of red flags from questionnaire: they require quarterly key rotation with provable key destruction for old keys. We support rotation, but provable destruction for external HSMs depends on vendor. Marking as "depends" and requesting vendor attestation.

amy-sales: Great, that's fine. I'll compile today and send a unified response with the capability matrix and pricing appendix. Action items: @kevin-solutions draft matrix + pricing (due TOMORROW 9am), @raj-eng HSM snippet + fallback paragraph (due TODAY 3pm), @lisa-security complete security Q by EOD. I'll pull together final bundle and legal will review. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployment note: shared doc created -> s3://redwood-sales/edgebank/rfp-bundle-1728123456.zip

amy-sales: Thanks everyone — really appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll ping legal now for SLA clauses.
